# Collingwood Heating & Cooling

> Serving Collingwood and the wider Simcoe County region, Collingwood Heating & Cooling is a home comfort contractor covering furnace repair, air conditioner service, ductless installation, heat pumps, fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning for Ontario homeowners.

Phone: (705) 998-7421  |  Email: contact@collingwoodheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://collingwoodheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Collingwood, Wasaga Beach, Stayner, Creemore, Thornbury, The Blue Mountains, Nottawa, Clarksburg, Blue Mountain Village
